module.name: License Activation Gate
module.description: Cloud-agnostic apply-then-gate for the BNK License CR. Waits for the licenses.k8s.f5net.com CRD, server-side-applies the License CR (connected mode, JWT inlined to a 0600 temp file, never logged), then polls .status.state until Active, dumps pod diagnostics and fails closed on timeout. Ported from awsbnkctl phase23_license.go + phase25_activation_poll.go. Per-cloud catalogs vendor this and call it after their cneinstance readiness gate.

required.reason: Applies the License CR against the CNEInstance namespace; provides cneinstance_namespace. Must also run after the readiness gate (wired via the blueprint chain).

required.name: license_namespace
required.description: Namespace the License CR is applied into. Wired from cneinstall.cneinstance_namespace.

required.name: jwt_token
required.description: Raw F5 BNK JWT licensing token. Inlined into spec.jwt. Never logged.

optional.name: kubeconfig_file
optional.description: Path to an existing kubeconfig. Empty = materialise from forge_kubeconfig_content.

optional.name: license_name
optional.description: Name of the License CR to apply and poll.

optional.name: license_crd_name
optional.description: Fully-qualified License CRD name for the CRD pre-gate.

optional.name: activation_timeout_seconds
optional.description: Max seconds to wait for License .status.state == Active before failing closed.

optional.name: crd_timeout_seconds
optional.description: Max seconds to wait for the License CRD to be registered.

key_outputs.name: license_active
key_outputs.description: Gate output — the activation null_resource id, produced only after the operator reported License .status.state == Active. Never a literal true.

key_outputs.name: license_namespace
key_outputs.description: Namespace where the License CR was applied.

key_outputs.name: license_name
key_outputs.description: Name of the applied License CR.
